name: Bond ETF (Aggregate / Treasury)

yield.notes: AGG, BND, TLT type funds. Inverse price/yield relationship.

flags: Inverse price/yield relationship: price drops as rates rise
Duration risk: long-term bonds most sensitive to rate changes
Used as portfolio diversifier, not pure income

startup_checklist: Choose fund type: short-term (BSV, SHY — low rate risk) vs aggregate (BND, AGG)
Allocate fixed percentage of portfolio (e.g., 20-40% as ballast)
Review duration exposure annually and adjust if rate environment changes
failure_modes: Rate hike cycle crushes NAV on long-duration bonds
kill_criteria: Real yield (nominal - inflation) turns negative and stays there
Better risk-adjusted yield available in HYSA/T-Bills with same safety
sources_note: Yield data from ETF provider SEC yield disclosures.
